title: People’s Mañanera April 13
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference_  _and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available  [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**7.2 million students receive support: stipends as an investment in the
future  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum announced that more than 7.2 million elementary
school students will receive economic support for purchasing school supplies
and uniforms, a measure that helps strengthen family finances.

Record levels are being reached in the following programs: 8.2 million
students in Rita Cetina, 4.1 million in Benito Juárez, 423,000 in Jóvenes
Escribiendo el Futuro (Youth Writing the Future), and 56,000 in Gertrudis
Bocanegra. Plans include an investment of 1.1 trillion pesos (US$63.49
billion) and 129.5 million beneficiaries by 2030. In addition, public
education is being promoted with more schools, teachers, and better
conditions.

**Fuel: intervention to curb abuses  
** Sheinbaum noted that, without government intervention, gasoline would
exceed 30 pesos (US$1.73) and diesel 32–33 pesos (US$1.85-1.90) per liter,
given the international rise in oil prices above US$100 per barrel. The price
cap remains at 24 pesos (US$1.39) for regular gasoline and 28 pesos (US$1.62)
for diesel, with the goal of lowering them.

This entails support of nearly 5 billion pesos (US$290 million), offset by
Pemex revenues, equivalent to around 2.5 billion pesos (US$140 million)
weekly. The President warned of impacts on the basic food basket and announced
meetings with gas station owners and the PACIC anti-inflation pact to prevent
abuses and protect the population’s economy.

**Mexico–Spain: Historical Memory and Foreign Policy with Dignity  
** Sheinbaum highlighted King Felipe’s recognition of indigenous cultures as a
step forward in an assessment of the Spanish colonization of Mexico. The
President reaffirmed that, despite López Obrador’s call for an official
apology, relations between the two countries were never severed. During
Sheinbaum’s visit to Spain, a clear position will be taken: the conquest
involved violence, imposition, and plunder, along with the assertion that
Indigenous civilizations were advanced. The message will be self-
determination, non-intervention, peace, and international recognition of
Indigenous peoples.

**Well-being Hubs: Investment with Territorial Justice  
** The President announced that the Tlaxcala model will be replicated
nationwide, promoting industry and manufacturing alongside well-being. It
integrates infrastructure, housing, and services near workplaces; in Tlaxcala,
urban development came first, then land was sold, and the state retains
administrative control. The debt-free plan is already attracting businesses
and fostering orderly growth with social justice.
